'''Boldclaw''' is a [[Water]] type [[Tank]] [[Tatari]]. It evolves from [[Shellshy]] at 6 stars.

==Overview==
Current Description: "To evolve into Boldclaw, one must manage to get an extra large from Shellbucks without spending a dime."

Boldclaw is an early game, purple rarity Tatari.

==Appearance==
A large, orange hermit crab with a pointed, cone-shaped, light blue shell. It has a variety of spikes all over the shell, and there's a subtle swirl shape at the front. Its body is visible beneath the shell, and it has two large angry eyes. 

== Trivia ==

* Prior to the update on 3/11/2026, its bio description said: "Boldclaw evolved without spending an extra dime-just reused an extra large from Shellbucks."
* Prior to the update on 5/13/26, its bio description said: "Boldclaw wields two massive orange claws and is known to aggressively clamp onto bigger foes. Frequently competes with [[Clawzor]] for territory."

==Strategy==
[[File:Boldclaw Attack Range.png|x200px|left|thumb|Boldclaw's attack range]]
Good early game tank. Works well with any backliners, but pairs well with [[Droppit]] and its evolutions due to their slowing abilities.
